app.title: mccboard
language.label: Language
instances.title: Instances
instances.subtitle: Claude Code instances mccboard manages, grouped by account.
instances.empty: No instances found: no ~/.claude or ~/.claude-* folder in your home.
login.renews_hint: Claude Code renews it automatically whenever it runs.
login.token_expired_hint: Open Claude Code in this instance to renew it: you're still logged in.
error.home_unreadable: mccboard can't read your home folder.
error.unknown: Something went wrong while talking to mccboard's core.
section.proposals_hint: Scanning only proposes folders: register the ones mccboard should manage.
registered.empty: No instance registered yet. Register one found below, or any folder by path.
register_path.label: Register a folder by path
account.field.label: Label
account.no_account_hint: Instances that weren't logged in when they were registered.
account.unknown_hint: This account isn't in config.toml. Register one of its instances again to add it.
status.changed: Now logged in as {account}, not with the account it was registered with ({registered}).
status.unrecorded: Logged in as {account} since it was registered.
notice.new_account: New account “{label}” added: you can change its label and color.
error.config_corrupt: config.toml isn't valid, so mccboard won't change it. Fix it by hand: this window updates as soon as you save it.
error.relative_path: Give a full path, or one starting with ~.
error.label_taken: Another account already has that label.
error.invalid_launcher: A launcher name uses letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.', and can't be “claude”.
drift.problem.missing_link: {item} is missing: it should be a link to the primary instance's {item}.
drift.problem.unlinked_skill: The personal skill “{skill}” is in the primary instance but isn't linked here, so this account can't use it.
drift.problem.broken_link: {item} is a link to {target}, which doesn't exist.
drift.problem.broken_link_unreadable: {item} is a link that can't be read.
drift.problem.wrong_target: {item} is a link to {target}, not to the primary instance's {item}.
drift.problem.link_chain: {item} is a link to {target}, which is a link itself: more than one hop. Claude Code saves settings by following a single hop, so a chain can break.
drift.problem.not_a_link: {item} is a separate copy, not a link to the primary instance's {item}, so changes to one don't reach the other.
drift.problem.whole_folder_link.skills: skills is linked as a whole folder, so every account shares the same skills/synced folder, where Claude Code keeps each account's claude.ai skills.
drift.problem.whole_folder_link.plugins: plugins is linked as a whole folder, which breaks plugin marketplace validation in both instances.
drift.repair.replace_link: replace it with a single link to {target}.
drift.repair.backup_and_link: move this copy to a backup in ~/.mccboard/state/, then link {item} to {target}.
drift.repair.migrate_skills: make skills a real folder in this instance with one link per personal skill ({skills}), and keep this account's skills/synced private.
drift.repair.migrate_skills_none: make skills a real folder in this instance, and keep this account's skills/synced private.
drift.repair.migrate_plugins: give this instance its own plugins folder; its plugins are then reinstalled with Claude Code's own commands.
drift.problem.missing_launcher: The launcher {item} is missing, so no command starts Claude Code in this instance.
drift.problem.stale_launcher: The launcher {item} isn't the one mccboard writes: it was edited by hand, is incomplete or comes from an earlier version.
drift.problem.stale_launcher_found: The launcher {item} starts Claude Code in {found} instead of this instance.
drift.repair.sync_launchers: fix the launchers, then open a new terminal.
drift.problem.misaligned_key: The Global config key {key} is {instance} here but {primary} in the primary instance.
drift.problem.misaligned_key_unset: The Global config key {key} isn't set here; the primary instance has {primary}.
drift.problem.missing_marketplace: The plugin marketplace {marketplace} is added in the primary instance but not here.
drift.problem.missing_plugin: The plugin {plugin} is installed in the primary instance but not here, so this account doesn't have it.
drift.repair.align_key: set {key} to {value} in this instance's .claude.json, leaving every other key as it is.
drift.repair.add_marketplace: add it with “claude plugin marketplace add {source}”, run in this instance.
drift.repair.add_marketplace_by_hand: mccboard can't tell how to add it: add it by hand with “claude plugin marketplace add”, run in this instance.
drift.repair.install_plugin: install it with “claude plugin install {plugin}”, run in this instance (adding its marketplace first if needed).
sharing.title: Unknown items in the primary instance
sharing.hint: mccboard doesn't know these. Choose once whether every linked instance links each one from the primary instance or keeps it private; the answer is saved in config.toml.
notice.shared_link: {item} will be linked from the primary instance in every linked instance.
error.invalid_sharing_item: Only unknown items of the primary instance take an answer.
launcher.primary_hint: The primary instance keeps plain claude.
launchers.title: Launchers
launchers.not_on_path: This folder isn't on your user PATH, so terminals won't find the launchers.
launchers.orphan: {name} isn't needed by any registered instance any more.
launchers.none: No linked instance registered, so no launcher is needed.
notice.new_terminal: Open a new terminal to use them.
notice.path_added: Added {path} to your user PATH: open a new terminal to use the launchers.
notice.path_not_added: Couldn't add {path} to your user PATH: add it by hand.
error.launcher_unreadable: mccboard can't read the file or folder that holds the launchers.
error.launcher_unwritable: mccboard can't write the launchers. Any other change was saved.
error.launcher_block_corrupt: mccboard's block in your shell's rc file has lost its end marker. Fix or remove it by hand: mccboard won't rewrite it.
error.launcher_shim_missing: mccboard can't write the launchers: its launcher program, mccboard-shim.exe, is missing next to mccboard. Reinstall mccboard. Any other change was saved.
action.repair_hint: Fix this instance's drift. Copies replaced by links are first backed up in ~/.mccboard/state/backups/.
repair.item_backup: done; the copy that was there is in {backup}
error.instance_in_use: Claude Code is running in this instance, so mccboard won't change it. Close these sessions, then try again. Nothing was changed.
error.developer_mode_off: Linking files on Windows needs Developer Mode, which is off. Turn it on in Settings › System › For developers, then repair again. Nothing was changed.
error.desktop_app_folder: This folder is inside the Claude desktop app's data folder, where mccboard never creates links. Nothing was changed.
error.drift_item_not_found: That drift item isn't there any more: it may be repaired already.
error.invalid_language: That isn’t a language mccboard speaks: use English or Italian.
action.remove_hint: Remove this instance from mccboard, or delete its folder too.
remove.title: Remove this instance
remove.from_mccboard_hint: mccboard forgets this instance and deletes its launcher. The folder stays as it is, so you can register it again later.
remove.with_folder_hint: Deletes the folder with everything in it: login, history, sessions. Links to the primary instance are removed, never what they point to. Refused while Claude Code runs in this instance.
remove.confirm_login: I understand that the login of {account} on this machine will be gone.
remove.confirm_login_no_account: I understand that everything in this folder will be gone.
notice.removed: Removed {path} from mccboard, with its launcher. Its folder is untouched.
notice.removed_deleted: Removed {path} and its launcher, and deleted its folder.
notice.removed_already_gone: Removed {path} and its launcher. Its folder was already gone.
error.primary_instance: The primary instance is never removed or deleted by mccboard.
error.folder_not_deletable: mccboard won't delete this folder: it holds your home folder, the primary instance or mccboard's own files, sits inside the primary instance, or is a link. Nothing was changed.
error.folder_not_deleted: mccboard couldn't delete the whole folder. The instance is still registered: close whatever uses the folder, then remove it again.
add.title: Add a linked instance
add.hint: For another account: mccboard creates the folder, links and aligns it with the primary instance, creates its launcher, then opens Claude Code's login. Adding again completes whatever is missing.
add.label: Account label
action.login_hint: Open Claude Code's login for this instance. You log in in the browser; mccboard never sees the credentials.
login.waiting: Claude Code's login is open in a new window: log in in your browser. This window updates when the login ends.
notice.logged_in_new: {path} is logged in with a new account, “{label}”: you can change its label and color.
notice.not_logged_in: No account is logged in to {path}: it stays registered as not logged in. Use “Log in” to try again.
notice.add_questions: Some items of the primary instance weren't linked: answer the questions above, then Add again.
warning.account_has_other_instances: Account “{label}” already has an instance on this machine ({paths}). Was the right account used in the browser?
error.folder_not_addable: mccboard won't make an instance in this folder: it holds your home folder, the primary instance or mccboard's own files, sits inside one of them, or is a link. Nothing was changed.
error.folder_has_another_account: This folder already belongs to another account, whose label is shown below: choose another folder, or log it in again with the right account. Nothing was changed.
error.no_default_folder: That label gives no folder name: choose the folder yourself.
error.claude_not_installed: Claude Code (claude) isn't installed or isn't on the PATH. Install it, then try again: everything else is done.
error.instance_folder_missing: This instance's folder doesn't exist any more, so there is nothing to log in to. Add the instance again, or remove it.
error.login_needs_terminal: mccboard couldn't open a terminal window for the login here. Open a terminal and run “mccboard login” with this folder; everything else is done.
error.login_not_opened: mccboard couldn't open Claude Code's login. Everything else is done: try “Log in” again.
error.no_local_instance: This account has no local instance, which a desktop profile needs for its Code sessions. Add an instance for it first. Nothing was changed.
error.desktop_profile_exists: This account already has a desktop profile: one per account. Nothing was changed.
error.default_desktop_profile_account: This is the primary instance's account: the default desktop profile, the app as it starts normally, is its desktop profile already. Nothing was changed.
error.desktop_profile_folder_not_allowed: This folder is inside a Claude Code instance, mccboard's own files, the Claude desktop app's data or another desktop profile's folder, holds one of them, or is a link. Choose another data folder. Nothing was changed.
error.desktop_profile_not_found: This account has no desktop profile.
error.default_desktop_profile: The default desktop profile is the Claude desktop app as it is: mccboard never removes or changes it.
error.default_profile_color: This account is the default desktop profile's, which always shows Claude's own orange: its color can't be changed.
error.desktop_profile_in_use: The Claude desktop app is using this desktop profile's data folder. Close the profile, then try again. Nothing was changed.
error.no_icon_source: The Claude desktop app's logo wasn't found, so this desktop profile can't get its colored icon.
error.icon_source_unreadable: The Claude desktop app's logo can't be read, so this desktop profile can't get its colored icon.
error.icon_unwritable: The desktop profile's icon can't be written to mccboard's folder.
error.desktop_app_needs_windows: Desktop profiles open on Windows only, where the Claude desktop app runs.
error.desktop_app_not_installed: The Claude desktop app isn't installed. Install it from claude.ai/download or the Microsoft Store, then try again.
error.desktop_app_not_msix: This Claude desktop app comes from the old installer, which desktop profiles don't support. Install the current app from claude.ai/download or the Microsoft Store, then try again.
error.desktop_app_not_opened: The Claude desktop app couldn't be opened.
